name: Kill
overview: The Bible clearly commands not to kill, as stated in Exodus 20:13, emphasizing the sanctity of human life. Jesus teaches in Matthew 10:28 that while the body can be killed, the soul is eternal and only God has authority over both body and soul in hell. Furthermore, Romans 13:10 explains that love fulfills the law by doing no harm to others, reinforcing the call to protect and value life rather than destroy it.
